notes: Cover audit, 2026-11-10. The owner, on Social: the weekly challenge's photo is poor quality; find a better one and check whether any others are low quality, at the marathon and space covers' bar. All 85 covers were drawn in every band they are used in (object-fit: cover, 2x) and their darkest flat area checked at 3.25x brightness. Six were weak. Four race and space covers are replaced here, each from a 2400 px Unsplash source whose download was registered through the Unsplash API, encoded as 1200 x 600 WebP under 120,000 bytes, original colour, no retouching. Each record says what it replaces and why. The earlier records of the replaced files stay in their own manifests as history. The sixth, challenge-weekly, is not replaced: challenges move to their own medal art (Soc16), so no challenge carries a photograph. space-runners was listed too and keeps its photograph: the owner kept a replacement only where it was clearly better (2026-11-10), and its group running towards the camera is sharp enough at card size.

images.subject: Plaza de España, Seville, from the upper gallery: the semicircular brick building, the canal with its tiled bridges, the Vicente Traver fountain and the north tower, under broken cloud.

images.replaces: space-seville-marathon (Jose Manuel Esp, fisheye view of the same plaza). Bent verticals, the towers pushed to the band edges, and empty paving plus two tourists filling the centre of every band; soft (Laplacian variance 169). Same landmark, now straight and sharp, with the building across the whole band.
images.locationEvidence: The caption names no place ('a large building with a fountain in front of it'). Identified from the photograph: Plaza de España in the Parque de María Luisa, Seville - the semicircular Regionalist building with its two towers, the moat crossed by tiled bridges, the central Vicente Traver fountain and the striped paving of the plaza. Returned by a search for 'Plaza de España Seville'; the same place as the cover it replaces.
